subject: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount
content:
From: Asha Patel <asha@launchfoundry.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the accelerator support. Quick question from our finance and infra teams: we have a cohort allocation of $75k in promotional credits that expire at the end of August. Wed like to explore converting some or all of that into committed Reserved/Dedicated capacity (to get predictable throughput for coming demos), ideally with:

- a staged conversion (e.g., convert $25k now, $25k in September, remainder on acceptance of next milestone)
- a one-time bulk conversion discount or uplift if we commit to a 12-mo reserved pool
- extension to the expiration date while conversion is being finalized

I attached an internal summary (launchfoundry-credit-plan.xlsx) for context. Can Redwood make an exception here or suggest the cleanest path? Also looping Gabe from SeedWorks who is advising our infra choices.

Appreciate your help,
Asha Patel
Head of Growth, LaunchFoundry
asha@launchfoundry.com

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha@launchfoundry.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount

Thanks Asha, this is helpful. Looping Ben (sales) for pricing and Laura (finance) for billing/contract constraints.

High level we can do: staged conversion + a conversion rate that accounts for committed discount tiers. There are a few moving pieces (credit expiration, amortization on finance side, and reserved capacity SKU mapping) so wed like to propose a short options memo for you and your CFO: 1) token conversion to committed spend with tiered discount, 2) credits applied as prepayment with monthly drawdown, or 3) credits converted to multi-month seat/instance credits (hybrid). Ben, can you draft options and call out timelines? Laura, any must-have billing notes?

Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha@launchfoundry.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount

Hi Asha and Gabe,

Appreciate the note. Below are pragmatic options were prepared to offer (draft pricing for discussion):

1) Staged Reserved Conversion (recommended)
   - Convert promo credits to Reserved capacity commitment at a 0.85 conversion factor (i.e., $75k promo -> $63.75k committed year-1 value)
   - Well allow three conversion tranches within a 120-day window (max 3 draws)
   - If you convert to a 12-mo reserved pool, we apply an extra 7% discount to the committed rate

2) Prepaid Credit Roll (simpler bookkeeping)
   - Credits become a Redwood prepayment balance that can be applied to Dedicated invoices. No expiration during negotiation window (60 days).
   - No additional conversion discount beyond standard committed pricing.

3) Hybrid Seat Guarantee
   - Convert credits to a minimum seat/instance reservation for demo months; any overage billed at usage. Better for short-term demo bursts.

Other items:
- We can pause expiration for up to 45 days while contracts are finalized.
- DocuSign path available; Ive attached proposal-draft.pdf with illustrative numbers.
- Suggested next step: 30-min call this week to lock tranche sizes and confirm accounting flow.

Deal id DF-2028-LF-312 in HubSpot (link below). If you want a tighter conversion factor for larger commit sizes we can escalate, but the 7% add-on eeks out margin for the reserved capacity discount.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@launchfoundry.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount

Couple of finance notes for Asha and Gabe:

- For customer accounting, we treat promo credits as contra-revenue; converting to committed contracts requires recognizing revenue over the committed period. We need an SOW that maps the converted amount to the reserved SKU and a start date.
- We can accommodate a 90-day invoice deferral on signature for this cohort (to help cashflow), but the contract must include an amortization schedule.
- Extension requests to original promo expiry: operations can approve a 45-day hold but anything beyond that requires Product Ops sign-off.

Ive attached SOW-draft.docx with the reserved SKU placeholders and a sample amortization schedule. If youre comfortable, we can run a 15-min call with accounting to walk through the amortization.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Asha Patel <asha@launchfoundry.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Gabe Turner <gabe.turner@seedworks.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Converting accelerator credits to Dedicated capacity - staged conversion + bulk discount

Thanks all this is exactly the level of specificity we needed. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- Were going to take Option 1 (Staged Reserved Conversion) and plan to convert $25k now, $25k on Sep 1, and hold the final tranche pending product milestone acceptance (expected Nov).
- We accept the 0.85 base conversion factor and will request the 7% extra discount on commit (pending internal approval).
- Wed like the 45-day hold on expiry while legal and accounting finalize. If Product Ops needs more time well escalate on our side.

Next steps: Ben to issue a one-page amendment reflecting the tranche schedule and conversion factor; Laura to provide the SOW line items to attach. Well aim to sign by Jul 10.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Warmly,
Asha

---

[Attachments referenced above: launchfoundry-credit-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposal-draft.pdf (1pg), SOW-draft.docx (template)]
